nodes.title: Enter Positive Prompt Here
widgets_values: A photorealistic illustration of a majestic orange tabby cat in a tuxedo.

To create a high-quality and beautiful image based on your description, consider the following prompt:

Composition: The image should be a double exposure scene where the fiery eyes and lips are prominently featured in the foreground, capturing intense emotions. The mystical dragon and serene turtle with a mystical castle on its back should be seamlessly integrated into the background, creating a harmonious blend.

Lighting: Use dramatic and contrasting lighting to highlight the fiery eyes and lips, giving them an intense glow. Soft, ethereal lighting should illuminate the dragon and turtle, enhancing their mystical aura.

Design: The design should be intricate, with detailed scales on the dragon and a textured shell on the turtle. The castle should have traditional Japanese architectural elements, such as pagodas and torii gates.

Style: The style should be a blend of surrealism and fantasy, with vibrant colors for the fiery elements and a more subdued, mystical palette for the dragon and turtle.

Camera Lens Information: Use a wide-angle lens to capture the expansive scene, ensuring all elements are in focus and well-defined.

Camera Angle: A slightly elevated angle should be used to give a sense of grandeur and depth to the scene, allowing viewers to appreciate the intricate details of both layers.

Time of Day: Set the scene during twilight, where the fiery elements contrast beautifully against the darkening sky, and the mystical elements are bathed in the soft glow of the setting sun.

Detailed Description of Character and Emotion: The fiery eyes and lips should convey intense emotions such as passion and determination. The dragon should appear majestic and powerful, while the turtle exudes calmness and wisdom. The mystical castle should evoke a sense of wonder and enchantment.

Background: A dark background should be used to enhance the contrast and make the vibrant elements stand out, while also adding depth to the overall composition.

Create a photorealistic image of a US Navy Sturgeon-class submarine broaching out of the water at a very steep angle. The composition should capture the dynamic motion of the submarine as it emerges from the ocean, with water cascading off its hull. Use dramatic lighting to highlight the sleek design of the submarine, emphasizing its powerful presence. The style should be realistic, with attention to detail in the textures of the submarine and the ocean. Use a wide-angle lens to capture the full scale of the scene, with a low camera angle to enhance the sense of power and motion. Set the scene during the golden hour, either at sunrise or sunset, to add warmth and contrast to the image. The submarine should appear formidable and majestic, evoking a sense of awe and respect for its engineering and capabilities.
